definitions.explanation: The building where a legislative assembly meets to deliberate. In Japan it most often refers to the National Diet Building, the {国会|こっかい}{議事堂|ぎじどう}.

examples.japanese: {国会|こっかい}{議事堂|ぎじどう}を{見学|けんがく}する。
examples.english: to tour the National Diet Building.

examples.japanese: {議事堂|ぎじどう}の{前|まえ}で{抗議|こうぎ}{活動|かつどう}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A protest was held in front of the assembly building.

examples.japanese: {修学|しゅうがく}{旅行|りょこう}で{東京|とうきょう}を{訪|おとず}れ、{初|はじ}めて{国会|こっかい}{議事堂|ぎじどう}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: On our school trip we visited Tokyo and saw the National Diet Building for the first time.

notes:
Combines {議事|ぎじ} (proceedings, deliberation) + {堂|どう} (hall). The hall or building where a legislature meets. In Japan it almost always means the {国会|こっかい}{議事堂|ぎじどう} (National Diet Building).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国会|こっかい}{議事堂|ぎじどう}: National Diet Building
- {議事堂|ぎじどう}{前|まえ}: in front of the assembly hall
- {県|けん}{議会|ぎかい}{議事堂|ぎじどう}: prefectural assembly hall
